Sample Submission. The bidder shall submit samples of the quoted items,, within two (02) days fr om the date of opening of the bid or from the date of intimation by the Buyer/Committee, as applicable. Failure to submit the required samples within the stipulated time shall render the bid liable for rejection. Samples shall be submitted free of cost and shall not be returned unless sp ecifically decided by the Buyer. The Technical Evaluation Committee shall have the right to examine an d reject any sample. The decision of the Committee in this regard shall be fin al for the purpose of technical evaluation. 3. Analytical Report / Quality Control Report Mandator y with Supply. The supplier shall mandatorily submit the Analytical Report / Quality Contro l Report along with the supplied items. The Analytical/Quality Control Report shall: Be issued by the manufacturer's Quality Control Laboratory or a NABL-acc redited/Government-approved laboratory, wherever applicable; Correspond to the batch number of the supplied items; Clearly mention the Batch No., Manufacturing Date, Expiry Date and relevant test results/compliance; and Establish conformity of the supplied item with the prescribed quality stand ards/specifications. Supply without the required Analytical/Quality Control Report shall be treated a s incomplete and liable for rejection, and payment shall not be processed u ntil the required documents are furnished and the supply is accepted. 4. Price Inclusive of All Taxes and Charges. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties and inci dental charges, including but not limited to: GST; Transportation/Freight; Loading and unloading charges; Packing and forwarding charges;

Insurance; and Any other incidental expenses. No additional charges over and above the accepted/quoted price shall be payab le by the Buyer. The quoted rates shall remain firm during the entire contract period, subje ct to applicable Government/GeM provisions. 5. Product Quality and Shelf Life. All items supplied shall strictly conform to the specifications, standards an d requirements prescribed in the bid. Items supplied shall be new, unused and of standard quality. Medicines/drugs supplied shall have a minimum 75% remaining shelf lif e or 18 months validity, whichever is higher, at the time of delivery, wherever applicable. Expired, damaged, substandard, short-dated or otherwise non-conforming items shall be liable for rejection. The supplier shall bear all costs associated with the replacement of rejecte d items. 6. Delivery Period and Location. The supplier shall complete the supply within 07 to 15 days from the date o f issue of the GeM Contract/Purchase Order, as specified in the contract/or der. Delivery Location: Government Children Hospital, Bemina, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir. The supplier shall ensure proper packing, transportation and safe delivery of the items at the designated location. 7. Inspection and Acceptance. The supplied items shall be subject to inspection and verification by the Consig nee and/or Technical Evaluation Committee/authorized inspection tea m. Inspection may include verification of: Quality; Technical specifications; Quantity; Batch number; Manufacturing and expiry dates; Shelf life; Analytical/Quality Control Report; and Any other relevant requirement specified in the bid. The Buyer reserves the right to reject any item that does not conform to t he prescribed specifications, quality standards, quantity, documentati on or other terms and conditions of the bid.

8. Replacement of Rejected/Defective Items. Any item found to be defective, damaged, substandard, short-dated or n ot conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced by the su pplier within 07 days of receipt of intimation from the Buyer , at no additio nal cost to the Buyer. The replacement items shall comply with all prescribed quality and shelf-life req uirements. 9. Liquidated Damages (LD). In the event of failure by the supplier to deliver the items within the stipulated d elivery period, Liquidated Damages may be imposed at the rate of 0.5% per week of the delayed supply, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total order value, in accordance with applicable GeM/Government provisions. 10. Payment Terms. Payment shall be made only after: Successful delivery of the ordered items; Inspection and acceptance by the authorized committee/consignee; Submission and verification of the required Analytical/Quality Control Repo rt and other prescribed documents; and Submission of the duly prepared bill/invoice in triplicate, wherever required . Payment shall be processed as per applicable GeM rules and Government financial procedures, subject to satisfactory acceptance of the supplies. 11. Buyer's Right to Reject/Cancel. The Buyer reserves the right to reject non-responsive bids or non-conformi ng supplies and to cancel/terminate the bid/order/contract in accordan ce with applicable GEM and Government rules, wherever warranted, including in the interest of patient care, uninterrupted availability of essential it ems and smooth functioning of the hospital 1.Dual heated Neonatal / Paediatric / Adult Ventilator circuit. Specifications . 1. 1.1 m Inspiratory tubing with spiral heating coil for uniform heating. 2. The circuit should be of similar make and be compatible with the existing servo controlled heated humidifier with ports for temperature and flow sen sors for feedback mechanism with proper documentation. 3. Expiratory limb made of moisture diffusing material without water trap. 4. Auto-fill humidification chamber with dual float mechanism for humidific ation upto 100 %. 5. Pressure line should be part of the circuit.

6. Suitable for bias flow and low flow ventilators. 7. Extension/dry line for ventilator to humidifier chamber and luer adaptor and port for NO delivery. 8. Adaptor for oxygen delivery using nasal cannula. 9. Swivel Y-piece with duck bill valve for suctioning. 10. Certification: It should be US FDA and European CE approved 11. Autheority letter. 2 Specifications - Nasal High Flow Junior Interface 1. Interface should be of similar make and be compatible with the existing HFNC machine with proper documentation. 2. Nasal Interface of 5 different sizes compatible with preterm, terms and i nfants from 2kg to 25kg. Should be compatible with a large range of patien ts. 3. Should have soft, flexible anatomically contoured nasal Interface, with te chnology to have interface retention. 4. It should facilitate kangaroo mother care 5. It should have hydrocolloid adhesive on Velcro to secure on skin. This sh ould be easily replaceable. 6. The interface should be kink proof and assist in reduced condensation 7. Should be also supplied with Wiggle pads separately if needed. 8. Certification: It should be US FDA and European CE approved 9. Authority Letter. 3. RAM CANNULA® NASAL OXYGEN CANNULA Specification. - For use with low/high flow oxygen - Should be able to deliver PEEP of 5cm H2O upto 8cm H2O - Should be capable to be connected with Resuscitation bag/T-piece Resusci tators to deliver CPAP/PPV - Should be capable of being connected with Ventilator on NIV mode to deli ver IMV/SIMV of CPAP or as a regular O2 Cannula. - Can be used with or without humidity - Soft, curved prongs - Color coded sizes - 15 mm oxygen tubing adapter included - Not made with natural rubber latex or plasticizer DEHP - Individually packaged

- Sizes : Preemie (Green), Newborn (Blue), Infant (Orange) - ISO 13485 certified, USFDA/CE Approved. - Authority Letter - Import License - Physical sample verification - In this Schedule, bidders from outside the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir are also eligible to participate. 4. Specifications of PD Catheter 1. Must have Multihole, open end catheter is manufactured from medical grade p olyamide 2. must have stainless steel trocar with triple angle sharpness to facilitate smoo th penetration. Roller clamp for flow control 3.The trocar and the tip of the catheter is perfectly matched to facilitate trauma free entry. 4.Latex free flash ball type injection port is provided on the junction unit for addi tional medication. 5.Complete kit is placed in thermoformed tray, packed in peelable pouch. 6. Pediatric and neonatal varients 7. Long handle scalpel blade 8. Shelf Life: 60 Months 9. should have perforate mark upto 50 mm with length varing from 130-170 mm 10. Must have Indian standard marking approval. .
